readings: For each event type (`event.type`), matching budget lines to events via `budget.link_to_event`, compute the average of `spent`/`amount` across its budget lines. Skip lines where spent or amount is NULL. Also show the signed difference (type average minus the mean of the per-type averages), so values can be negative.

For each event type (`event.type`), matching budget lines to events via `budget.link_to_event`, compute the average of `spent`/`amount` across its budget lines. Skip lines where spent or amount is NULL. Also show the absolute difference (always non-negative) between the type average and the mean of the per-type averages.
queries:
WITH type_avg AS (
    SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM type_avg) AS diff_from_mean
FROM type_avg;
WITH type_avg AS (
    SELECT e.type AS type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_ratio
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, avg_ratio, ABS(avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM type_avg)) AS abs_diff
FROM type_avg;
